map.为何增长率用几何均？: Why use the geometric mean for growth rates?
map.增长率复利相乘，几何均给出复合均值；算术均会高估（如 +50% 后 −50% 不: Growth rates compound multiplicatively, so the geometric mean gives the compound average; the arithmetic mean overstates it (a rise of 50% followed by a fall of 50% is not a zero return).
map.含负数/零？: What about negative values or zero?
map.几何均要求全为正，含零或负无意义（或需平移），比率常用对数后算算术均再指数化。: The geometric mean requires every value to be positive; with zeros or negatives it is undefined (or requires shifting the data). For ratios, take logarithms, average them and exponentiate.
